testcase.name: every bounded readiness failure has safe actionable copy and READY has no remedy
unknown reasons, contradictory readiness and provider error text never qualify or leak
lead, child and direct defaults remain independent, and malformed overrides never fall back
selection requires a listed active ready model with complete model metadata
ambiguous duplicate connection or model identity cannot be selected
model projections leave frozen defaults and unrelated draft/persona state intact
ready funding displays exact authenticated provider identity and explicit funder separately
funding mismatch in each immutable scope pin fails closed without exposing ready metadata
missing explicit funding ownership is never inferred from provider account metadata
expired, stale, failed and malformed funding views cannot retain a ready label
blocked funding uses only the bounded reason/remedy and suppresses all ready fields
funding scope extras cannot enter the ready projection and freshness must be explicitly true
a calendar-invalid future expiry is not normalized into fresh funding
